messages:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: PAGER — P1: high error-rate detected on inference-serving-prod (us-west2). Error rate >15% sustained for 3m. Paging dev-oncall and sre-oncall. Links: https://ops.redwood.example/incident/INC-5231
Anya: I'm on it, grabbing logs and GC/CPU metrics. Anyone seen deployment activity in the last 30m?
Liam: not from infra, last deploy was 02:05 UTC by release-bot. No config changes from prod-config.
Anya: ok. Initial check: 503 spikes across /v1/generate and websocket closes. Rolling count: 20% 503s last 5m on gw-node-.* us-west2.
Raj: i’m taking the page — Raj (sre) stepping in. Handoff at 11:07 PT. Anya pls continue with surface-levels, I'll coordinate comms and escalations.
Anya: copying logs excerpt here for quick eyeball:
```
2026-03-15T18:05:12Z gw-node-3 inference-request id=abc123 status=503 upstream=grpc://model-host:rpc error="connection reset by peer"
2026-03-15T18:05:13Z gw-node-7 inference-request id=def456 status=503 upstream=grpc://model-host:rpc error="context deadline exceeded"
2026-03-15T18:06:01Z cache-proxy kv-miss key=enc-prefix-hash ttl=0
```
Anya: also seeing surges in long-tail latency on model-host-2 (nvlink errors showed in dmesg), but need more confirm.
Sofia: marking affected customers: websocket sessions and streaming sessions see partial outputs then 503s. Non-streaming text gen also affected. Customer impact: many small PLG customers and 2 enterprise tenants in us-west2 (acct: acme corp, finex).
Kevin: I'm drafting a short status page update. Proposal below, please validate tone and owner.
Kevin: DRAFT STATUS (short):
> We are investigating elevated error rates affecting model inference in us-west2. Some requests are receiving 503s or partial responses. Our on-call team is actively mitigating. We will post updates every 30 minutes.
Kevin: Suggested audience: Public status page + email to finex and acme (account reps cc). Owner: ProductOps to publish public; Raj to send targeted account notes via sales ops.
Raj: +1. ProductOps take public. I'll send a targeted note to the two enterprise contacts once we have timeline/hypothesis.
ProductOps: got it — will publish. Can you add a one-line ETA for next update?
Raj: Next update T+30m (11:37 PT). Current mitigation priority: 1) fall back routing to model-host-1 pool, 2) drain/force-restart model-host-2 if nvlink errors confirmed, 3) enable degraded-mode cache-strict (temporarily) to reduce KV thrash.
Anya: running a small test: routing 5% of traffic to model-host-1 via cockpit. Command: `kubectl patch svc inference-gateway -p '{"spec": {"trafficSplit": {"model-host-1": 0.05}}}'`
Liam: capturing metrics snapshot (CPU/GPU/IO) and saving to GCS; link: gs://redwood-ops/incidents/INC-5231/metrics-1742001234.log
Anya: hypothesis 1: model-host-2 GPU driver/nvlink flakiness causing upstream GRPC resets. Hypothesis 2: sudden cache eviction pattern causing backend overload (cache stampede).
Raj: hypothesis tracking: please prefix any new hypothesis with H1/H2 and list confidence (low/med/high).
Anya: H1 — nvlink/driver flakiness, confidence: med. Evidence: dmesg showing nvlink errors and matching time window of 503s.
Liam: H2 — cache eviction stampede, confidence: low. Evidence: burst of KV misses around same time but not sufficient rate to fully account for 20% 503s.
Sofia: building timeline so far (relay additions welcomed):
- 18:03:50Z — increased latency observed by gateway monitoring (alerts threshold crossed)
- 18:04:05Z — PagerBot auto-detected sustained errors >15% (root cause unknown)
- 18:05:12Z — 503 errors spike on gw-node-3 and gw-node-7
- 18:06:00Z — cache proxy shows burst of KV misses
- 18:06:30Z — first nvlink error logged on model-host-2 dmesg
- 18:07:00Z — Raj takes over incident commander duties
- 18:10:00Z — test routing 5% traffic -> model-host-1 (results pending)
Raj: good. please add who did each action (owner) and add any comms sent.
Sofia: updated timeline with owners:
- 18:03:50Z — monitoring alert (PagerBot) — system
- 18:04:05Z — PagerBot page (PagerBot)
- 18:05:12Z — initial log surfacing (Anya)
- 18:06:00Z — KV miss pattern noted (Liam)
- 18:06:30Z — nvlink error observed (Anya)
- 18:07:00Z — incident commander handoff (Raj)
- 18:10:00Z — traffic split test initiated (Anya)
Raj: comms plan quick bullets:
- T+0: Short status page + ops channel note (Kevin/ProductOps) — done (in draft)
- T+30: Technical update (timeline, mitigation, impact) — Raj owner
- T+60: Root-cause update or mitigation summary — Raj + Anya
- Escalation: If error rate >10% after 90m escalate to infra on-call and exec brief.
ProductOps: publishing now to status page with Kevin's draft + note about targeted emails. Link to update: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-5231
ProductOps: posted public update: "Investigating elevated error rates impacting inference in us-west2. We are actively mitigating; next update in 30 minutes."
Raj: thanks. ProductOps pls include link to this thread in the status update as internal reference.
Anya: traffic split test results: 5% -> model-host-1 reduced 503s for that shard to ~2%, overall error rate fell from 18% to 11% in 3m. Rolling further to 25% might bring overall below 5% but we need safety checks.
Liam: GPU driver logs on model-host-2 show repeated nvlink timeouts and a process OOM on model runtime around 18:04:40Z. Dump attached to GCS: gs://redwood-ops/incidents/INC-5231/modelhost2-dumps.txt
Sofia: notes for stakeholder email (short):
> We are investigating elevated errors in us-west2 causing failed/partial inference responses for some customers. Engineers have implemented routing changes to reduce impact; we will follow up with a technical timeline and mitigation summary.
Raj: assigning outreach: ProductOps to publish public update (done), SalesOps to notify Finex & Acme (Raj will draft, SalesOps will send).
Kevin: drafting targeted note to Acme/Finex now. Will CC account reps and include contact for technical bridge.
Anya: next immediate action: coordinate scheduled drain+restart for model-host-2 once sales outreach is queued. Plan: cordon node, drain path, restart runtime, monitor 10m.
Raj: agreed. Execute drain at 11:25 PT (T+18m).
ProductOps: will add a line to status page: "We have implemented a routing change that reduced errors; a host restart is planned and may cause brief additional failures while we drain traffic." Approving owner: Raj.
Liam: adding to timeline post-drain and saving final metrics snapshot.
Raj: OK team — keep updates short in this thread. Next technical update scheduled at 11:37 PT (T+30). If anything changes materially, ping #executive-ops and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
Anya: packing logs and steps into the incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.example/display/INC/INC-5231
Kevin: sent targeted customer note to Finex & Acme; included tech contact and status link.
ProductOps: posted T+30 update with timeline and current mitigation steps.
Raj: thanks everyone. Postmortem/RCAs to be coordinated here — please drop full logs, kernel dmesg snippets, and the restart timeline. Mark any confirmed root-cause as H1/H2 accordingly.
Anya: H1 now increased to high confidence after restart saw nvlink errors clear and error rates drop to 1%.
Sofia: documenting impact window for customers: 18:03:50Z - 18:25:00Z (majority of errors), partial degradation until 18:40Z.
ProductOps: will hold a customer-facing summary doc and coordinate the PSR.
Raj: closing note for this thread: incident mitigated by routing + host restart; follow-up RCA to be drafted by Anya + Liam with timeline and recommended mitigations (driver upgrade + tighter cache TTLs). We will circulate draft to SRE/ProductOps by EOD.
Anya: will draft RCA and post here.
PagerBot: Incident INC-5231 status changed to: mitigated. Metrics back to expected baseline.
